name: portfolio-ai
description: Drop-in AI assistant for personal portfolios: answers recruiters about you from a JSON knowledge base (Claude Haiku + Vercel).
author: Vicente Hernaiz (https://vicentehernaiz.tech)

scripts.check: node --check api/chat.js && node --check api/usage-stats.js && node --check api/keepalive.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('config/knowledge.example.json','utf8'))"
